name: SimAdministrativeGender
title: Sim GeslachtCode to FHIR AdministrativeGender
description: Maps the sim source's raw GeslachtCode (test/data/sim/patient.csv) to FHIR's AdministrativeGender codes. group.source is left unset: GeslachtCode is a bare SQL string with no system attached by the pipeline, so asserting one here would overstate what's actually known - the M/F/UN values happen to match the Dutch zib GeslachtCodelijst's source system (http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-AdministrativeGender, see terminology/valuesets/decor_nictiz_nl_fhir_4_0_san-gen-_ValueSet_2_16_84-18f2ab567f0f.json) but that's inferred from the code values, not confirmed by the source data. Replaces the CASE WHEN that used to live in queries/sim/fhir/patient.sql.
